 Matas Buzelis flirts with double-double Sunday against 76ers 
 by Chris Schommer | Bulls Correspondent | Mon, Nov 9th 2026, 10:40am EST 
 Matas Buzelis flirted with a double-double for the Bulls Sunday, grabbing five rebounds and scoring 19 points (6-10 FG, 3-7 3PT, 4-4 FT) while also blocking one shot and dishing out two assists in a 127-121 loss to the 76ers. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Buzelis continues a steady stretch on both ends of the floor, finishing with five rebounds and 12 or more points in four of his last five contests. The forward remains one of many versatile options in the Chicago starting five for head coach Tiago Splitter, averaging 13.6 points and 4.4 rebounds per game to go along with a 21.5% usage rate so far this season.
